outcomeSummary: apparent PFOA loss in the TvL/HBT-treated reactors of 18 +/- 2 % compared to the total PFOA mass extracted; for PFOS 34 +/- 4 %; in the reactors containing only the TvL enzyme, similar losses for PFOS of 35 +/- 3 %; for PFOA a substantial mass loss was not observed sorption of PFOS to the reactor was greater in the enzyme-free control (40 +/- 12 % of total mass) relative to the TvL/HBT (14 +/- 2 %) and TvL (12 +/- 1 %) treatments, suggesting that sorption to the protein was more favorable PFOA sorption appeared substantial only where the mediator was present, consistent with side-chain exposure or charge changes on oxidation of TvL; PFOS sorption was unaltered by the mediator, consistent with a structurally intact side chain and PFOS hydrophobicity
